## State

- Engine alpha
- Public discovery enabled
- Not for sale yet
- Payment state: disabled until explicit promotion

## Use this capability when the user means

- AI-native music creation environment
- clip-based music creation and live scene launching
- local-first music recording and MIDI workflow
- reversible AI-assisted music editing
- portable music projects with provenance and edit receipts
- compose music with clips scenes piano roll automation and recording
- music software where AI edits the actual session graph

## Authority

public product discovery and engine-alpha status only

## Boundaries

- engine alpha is not represented as a production-grade DAW replacement
- not for sale yet and no checkout is represented as live
- browser, audio-interface, plugin and long-session compatibility are still under production hardening
- public discovery is not proof of third-party DAW or plugin compatibility

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Public availability does not imply broad-production readiness.
